name: jimdesigns.co (Design Subscription Studio)
description: One-person subscription-based design studio for SaaS startups. Made $18,000 in 7 months (~$2,570/mo). Side project turned real business — founder shares learnings on pricing, client acquisition via Twitter/LinkedIn.

name: AEO Checker
description: €500 MRR SEO tool for checking AI Engine Optimization (AEO) — how content ranks in AI search results. 3,000 users. 6th project, first to make money. Solo founder built it fast with 1 feature, validated demand before iterating.

name: Visa List
description: Comprehensive visa requirement lookup service. Grew to $5,000 MRR in one year. Monetized via affiliate partnerships + ads. Simple content site turned money maker.

name: Helpwise (Shared Inbox SaaS)
description: Shared inbox for teams (Slack-like for email). Reached $6,250 MRR in 77 days from launch. Competes with Front/HelpScout. Pricing starts $20/user/mo.

name: Lesso (Course Builder for Writers)
description: New platform (launched March 2026) for writers to build and sell courses. Direct monetization via course sales. Clean UI targeting creator economy.

name: changedetection.io
description: ⭐32K stars. Website change monitoring tool. Self-hosted open source + paid cloud plans. Passive monitoring SaaS — set and forget. Price tracking, restock alerts.

name: Relaticle CRM
description: ⭐1.4K. Open-source CRM with native AI agent support, 30 MCP tools. Built with Laravel + Filament. Self-hosted + cloud plans. Competes with HubSpot but open source + AI native.

name: QuantDinger
description: ⭐8.5K. AI quantitative trading platform — crypto, stocks, forex. Backtesting, live trading, multi-agent research. 'Vibe-trading' concept. Freemium model likely.

name: velobase-harness
description: ⭐518. Open-source SaaS boilerplate: 'From code to cash'. Stripe, affiliate, attribution & usage-based billing for AI apps. Built with T3 stack + Next.js 16. Template sold as premium.

name: Nanobrowser
description: ⭐13.3K. Open-source Chrome extension for AI-powered web automation. Multi-agent workflows with own LLM API key. Alternative to OpenAI Operator. Monetization via premium features or cloud hosting.

name: Skyeye ERP (云零代码)
description: ⭐623. 中国企业级零代码平台。Springboot + Uni-App。包含CRM/PM/ERP/MES/OA/EHR/AI等50+模块，自带SaaS多租户。典型中国式大而全B端产品。

name: OpnForm (开源表单)
description: ⭐3.5K. Beautiful open-source form builder. Laravel + Nuxt. Self-hosted free + cloud paid plans. Competes with Typeform/Jotform.

name: RevenueCat (YC S18)
description: In-app subscription management API. Launched 2018, now industry standard. Powers subscriptions for 30,000+ apps. Shows how a developer tool can become essential infrastructure.

name: jimdesigns.co
description: Subscription design studio for SaaS startups. One-person operation. $18K revenue in 7 months. Validates 'design-as-a-service' model with recurring pricing.

name: PropertyWizard.io
description: Side project reaching £544 MRR while founder worked full-time. Property management tool. Shows classic indie hacker path: build on the side until revenue supports full-time jump.

name: myapi (Autonomous Company API)
description: ⭐105. 'Unified API for autonomous companies. Ship a real business — website, backend, payments — from one terminal.' Very early stage (May 2026). AI-native business creation tool.

name: SaaS Mail (Cloudflare Email)
description: ⭐200. Self-hosted email server for SaaS teams on Cloudflare Workers. Free on CF infrastructure. Monetization via managed hosting or premium features.

name: ZeroStarter (SaaS Template)
description: ⭐52. Modern type-safe SaaS starter template with monorepo architecture. Monetization via template sales or premium features.

name: Saladict (沙拉查词)
description: ⭐13.2K. All-in-one pop-up dictionary Chrome extension. Supports multiple search modes, PDF translation. Free open source — monetization opportunity via premium dictionaries or API.

name: Subify (Shopify Subscriptions)
description: All-in-one subscription management toolkit for Shopify. Subscription box / recurring billing management. Shopify app ecosystem — $1B+ market.
